method: Sequential semantic reading in bounded case/annotation/unit/field batches; repeated values only compressed through exact earlier-occurrence references. Full sources and assigned guides read. Incremental case and annotation checkpoints preserved. Unanimous-looking claims checked directly against sources, without voting.
limits: This independent review is revisable AI judgment, not a reference truth set. Findings count bounded issues, not independent observations or a quality score.

All findings use each annotation's assigned guide. Version masking is incomplete because guides and schemas differ. No condition identities, agreement statistics, other review content or external research were accessed.

The frozen source packets bound factual conclusions. Missing edit/reply histories, exact intermediate changes, referenced-PR outcomes and unobserved actions remain missing; no external facts were supplied.
All 18 annotations, 587 retained units, 327 relations and 83 distinct packet entries were semantically inspected. Exact-anchor validation is separate from that semantic review.

No confirmed interpretation-changing execution failure was identified. Evidence-basis errors, convention deviations, criterion ambiguities, defensible alternatives and unresolved findings are kept distinct.
